source: Vacuum Fidelity V1b low-k conductivity convergence
decision: REVIEW. Geometry is converged, but the final conductivity decade does not satisfy the melt-Tmax and recoil plateau gates. Do not continue reducing cell k_void or advance directly to density/viscosity sensitivity. Reformulate the face conductivity used by the thermal Laplacian so a numerical void can retain benign cell properties without creating continuum conductive heat transfer across the metal-void interface.
